sources.role: cleaner contour and rendering style only

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / high-resolution illustration restoration.
Asset type: final-quality game-board BACKGROUND MASTER.
DELIVER NATIVE 3072 x 2048 pixels (3:2 landscape), a clean large-resolution PNG. Render actual resolved high-resolution illustration detail, not an enlarged blurry preview.
Input 1 = EDIT TARGET and authoritative layout: the latest Quackies base board with shortcut-blocking thickets and 8 shelters.
Input 2 = EARLIER STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its crisp deliberate contours and clean broad color modelling as guidance. Do NOT restore its uniform dirt routes, open interior, older access layout, or pasted-looking bridges.

PRIMARY WORK: Produce a clean, freshly resolved rendering of input 1 with the same composition, correcting both bridge integrations. Accumulated image-edit speckle, grain and fuzzy repetitive microtexture must be removed across the whole painting. Redraw clear leaf/blade/plank shapes and smooth painted color areas with controlled shading. Preserve the warm, playful, richly illustrated tabletop art; this is not photorealistic and not a flat minimalist vector map. Make it look like a skilled illustrator's clean finished game art at close inspection. Fine detail should come from intentional strokes, not noisy stippling. No film grain, canvas texture, random speckles, JPEG artifacts, oversharpening halos, smeared watercolor, or plastic 3D gloss. Make the grass corridors calmer with fewer larger directional strokes, and use readable grouped foliage rather than noisy leaf confetti. Keep the world lush and welcoming where appropriate.

BRIDGE 1, at top of water channel between left wetland and middle meadow:
Redraw the timber footbridge as a physical extension of the two banks, spanning LEFT to RIGHT. Extend its deck ends naturally onto low irregular stone-and-earth abutments embedded in each bank. The left returning grassy lane must curve naturally onto the open left end of the deck; the open right end must merge into the meadow's descending lane. Use modest weathered planks, beams visibly supported by the abutments, posts actually planted into bank/structure, and railings along the two long edges of the crossing, never across its walk-on ends. Add subtle moss and little grasses where the abutments meet the damp banks, coherent soft contact shadows beneath the deck and supports, and faint blue-green water bounce under the bridge. It must sit in the water-channel landscape, not appear as a frontal gate/icon pasted on top. Keep scale and crossing location close to input1; do not obstruct either approach.

BRIDGE 2, at the top of the rocky cleft between meadow and desert:
Also LEFT-to-RIGHT with open end access from the two route lanes. Use a matching simple timber bridge with earth/stone abutments embedded in the actual rocky cliff edges. Stonework on meadow side with a little grass; dry ochre rock and drifting sand at the desert-side foot. Deck blends into the bank levels, beams supported convincingly, posts anchored, correct perspective and contact/cast shadows in the cleft. Slightly drier sun-warmed timber than bridge1, same family of handmade construction. Do not add a separate platform floating above the terrain. Keep the existing gap and board footprint.

LAYOUT AND GAMEPLAY-READABILITY INVARIANTS:
- Same 3 tall side-by-side U-shaped routes, same camera, rounded wooden border, blank cream footer.
- Cool teal wetland with blue pond, reeds, willow; warm sunny GREEN wildflower grassland with tall gold-green seedhead grasses and shrubs; warm barren ochre desert with refuges.
- Dense reeds/willow thicket blocks direct travel from the upper-left unfinished nest to bridge1. The nest's DOWN route and returning right bank lane stay open.
- Dense connected meadow planting blocks shortcuts between and behind the 3 meadow shelters and between bridges. Do not reopen cross-island shortcuts.
- Keep all 8 shelters in their existing 2 wetland / 3 meadow / 3 desert locations and scale. Meadow shelter access is upper LEFT, middle RIGHT, lower DOWN: retain their short open dead-end grassy spurs. All shelter bowls remain clear and visible.
- Keep unfinished EMPTY nest at far upper left, waterfall oasis at furthest upper right. Preserve desert log shelter and lower rocky cave.
- Preserve the full width and geometry of all broad outer route corridors and bridge approaches for game spaces later; no plants or structures blocking them.
- Preserve composition rather than copying grainy pixels. Cleanly resolve all borders, foliage silhouettes, wood grain, rocks, flowers, water and ground; no wholesale layout redesign.
ABSOLUTELY NO game tiles/spaces, tokens, ducks, numbers, text, labels, icons, arrows, rewards or legend. The cream footer is clean and empty.
Output the finished clean native 3072x2048 board, high-resolution game illustration.
